title: Magadh University UG Admission Online Form 2026-30
intro: Short Information : Magadh University (Bodhgaya) has released the notification for the Graduation / Under Graduate/ Degree Course (B.A, B,.Com, B.Sc) For Academic Session 2026-30 for 4 year programme on the official website of the Magadh University. The online application process for Magadh University UG Admission Online Form 2026-30 has started on 24 April 2026, and candidates can apply untill 21 June 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Magadh University UG Admission Online Form 2026-30, which are given below.
applicationFee: Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.
